model: Zeppelin Mk. V Titanium Road Frame Set (Disc Brake)
description:
First introduced in the late 1990s, the original Zeppelin established a reputation as one of the finest titanium road bicycles of its time. Among the earliest direct-to-consumer titanium frames, it was admired for its refined ride quality, compliance, and exceptional durability — qualities that continue to be appreciated by discerning riders today.

The Zeppelin Mk. V advances this foundation with contemporary capability. Sharing the identical front triangle as the Mk. IV and maintaining near-identical geometry, it is designed for riders who require greater versatility and modern braking performance without compromise.

Key features:

UDH-compatible disc brake dropouts — confident, consistent stopping power and future-proof compatibility

Clearance for tires up to 38 mm — expanded range for varied surfaces and conditions

Premium double-butted 3Al-2.5V titanium tubing construction — natural compliance, superior vibration damping, and lifetime durability.

Advanced hydroformed titanium T/T and D/T — precisely engineered shapes for superior stiffness where you need it, compliance where you want it, and a strikingly modern, aggressive aesthetic.

SLM 3D Printed Grade 5 (6Al/4V) Titanium, Vacuum Annealed frame components: UDH Dropouts, Integrated T47 BB

Modern endurance-oriented geometry — composed handling, efficient power transfer, and all-day comfort

For riders seeking the refined character of the Zeppelin Mk. V with disc braking confidence and increased tire clearance, the Mk. V offers a purposeful, forward-looking evolution.
